note: Wave 3 site-v2 rebuild of the default split view. /homes-for-sale rewrites here; /search and /listings 301 here. The split view renders MapSearchView (the unified orchestrator); list + map views keep their existing components. Data: getViewportSearch -> getViewportListings (bbox + polygon aware, one set drives list + markers). Initial bounds seeded from getGeoBoundaryMapData (DAL).
